name: io.github.orldev/snail-mcp-security
description: Security checks of a working copy: packages, secrets, config and code, mapped to ENS and NIS2

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SECURITY_NOMAD_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: Nomad's HTTP address, which every scan runs through. Default: http://nomad:4646.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SECURITY_WORKSPACES_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Folder the platform's working copies lie under, as this server sees them, read-only. Default: /workspaces.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SECURITY_PROXY_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port the egress proxy for the scanners listens on inside the server; 0 keeps it off.

environmentVariables.name: SNAIL_MCP_SECURITY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Where the server answers. Default: http://127.0.0.1:8829/; inside a container the port is opened on every interface.
